label: INTERPRETATION_1 of a rule application: Interprets i a: i is an INTERPRETATION_1 of a, a further…
definition: `Interprets i a`: i is an interpretation of a, a further expression of the rule offered as what settles what accords with it at a ('einen Ausdruck der Regel durch einen anderen ersetzen', PU §201). Interpretations are themselves items that may be interpreted.
